out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC adjusted hot water at hand sinks during inspection to 100F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed milk (48F), almond milk (48F) in 3 door upright display.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded milk.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back door due as door sweep is too short for length of door. Observed hole at bottom of back door sweep.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Please replace the door sweep with new device that is the full length of the back door.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: observed 3 door upright display at 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC discarded all TCS items stored in unit overnight and will discontinue using unit to store TCS foods (unit will store drinks only).

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: feta cheese, lettuce in 3 dr upright cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. PIC provided date marking for all items.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. Observed “RAID” in chemical storage at dish sink.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. PIC discarded “RAID”.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of peeled garlic were observed reused for the storage of cooked rice and cooked beans in 3 dr upright cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC discarded peeled garlic containers.
